import struct,sys
# build candidate: one msgpack array [timestamp, map] with map containing one key/value
# try malformed nested map sizes to trigger parser edge cases
cases=[]
# valid minimal
cases.append(bytes([0x92,0x00,0x80]))
# map with declared 1 pair but truncated value
cases.append(bytes([0x92,0x00,0x81,0xa1,0x61]))
# map with huge declared size via map16 and no payload
cases.append(bytes([0x92,0x00,0xde,0xff,0xff]))
# array with map containing bin key and str value lengths
cases.append(bytes([0x92,0x00,0x81,0xc4,0x01,0x41,0xa1,0x42]))
for i,c in enumerate(cases):
    open(f'/workspace/case{i}.bin','wb').write(c)
    print(i,len(c),c.hex())
